author: mylyu
description:
M4Raw Brain v1.6
	

M4Raw Brain is a multi-contrast, multi-repetition, four-channel k-space
dataset acquired on a 0.3-T whole-body MRI system. The release contains T1w,
T2w, FLAIR, and GRE brain acquisitions from healthy volunteers, including
explicit motion subsets and an expanded repeated-acquisition test cohort.
